excerpt:
Policymakers have recently proposed requiring “AI kill switches” to quickly stop an AI system or limit the impact of a harmful or unwanted AI incident. This piece describes different potential implementations of AI kill switches at each layer of the AI stack and offers key takeaways for policymakers.

The post AI Kill Switches: What Policymakers Should Know appeared first on Center for Security and Emerging Technology.
